title: 第4738章 霸道的魂术第4737章 找到蛇前辈了
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九阳武神第4738章霸道的魂术（..la）不过很快，一大批混沌神反应了过来，开始合力围攻三头动物。
“就你们这些家伙，再多我也不怕。”
老牛杀得性起，两根牛角不断放大，呼啸着向前斩去。
以这三头动物的实力遇到混沌神级别的生灵根本就不会怕。之前他们之所以被打得那么惨，那是因为有开天神在其中。
两个开天神正在攻击那条大蛇，这两个开天神合力已经完全将那条大蛇镇压住，准备发动最后的攻击，彻底镇压大蛇，在这个关键的时刻，老牛、山羊还有猴子三头动物就刚好来了。
“又来了三头动物，这三头动物也是血脉不凡，都是古代的兽种。”
那两个开天神看到三头动物又惊又喜。
因为凭他们的感知能力，能感知得出来，这三头刚来到的动物体内的血脉十分古老，已经存活了漫长的岁月，浑身都是宝物。
“太好了，这里有四头血脉不凡的古兽，到时我们两个一人可以获得两头古兽。”
这两个开天神相互传音进行商量。
“只不过现在这四头动物聚在一起，整体实力不算弱，要对付他们，恐怕更难一些。”
其中一个开天神眉头轻皱。
“怕什么？
这四头古兽根本就不是我们两个的对手，更何况这里还有这么多的混沌神，肯定可以镇压他们的。”
另一个开天神则是不屑一顾，根本就不把这四头动物放在心上。
他们根本就不知道，这个时候混老已经在周围的空间中悄悄施展秘术控制这一片空间，叶云飞也在快速布置出一个个的阵法和地阵。
由于混老和叶云飞隐身的效果太好了，再加上混老一出手就扭曲隔绝了这一片空间，所以就连这两个开天神也没有发现叶云飞和混老的举动。
“大家不用慌张，这四头古兽最厉害的就是力量和它们坚硬的躯体，它们擅长的是近身作战，我们离它远一点，利用法宝和各种秘术隔空攻击，不给它们机会接近，这样就可以慢慢的消耗掉它们的战斗力，到时候它们就只能任由我们宰割了。”
其中一个开天神大声叫道。
不得不说，他的确是看出了这四头动物的特点。这四头动物古代追随大力魔神，最擅长的就是肉体力量以及坚硬无比的躯体，在战斗的过程中一旦让它们靠近，就要面对它们可怕无比的肉体和力量。

听了那个开天神的话，其他那些混沌神马上同时后退，然后祭出一件件法宝，施展各种功法秘术，开始隔空攻击这四头动物。
“就你们这些家伙，不管用什么方式战斗，也不是我们的对手。”
猴子冷笑说道，然后身形一闪，腾空而起，手中那根金色的铁棒不断放大，瞬间就化成了一根撑天之柱，犹如一堵金色的山脉，轰隆隆地向前横扫，一下子就将一大批攻击硬生生挡了回去。
接着山羊向前冲去，两只羊角不断放大，一下子就洞穿前方的空间。山羊的两只羊角蕴含着十分高明的空间法则，前方的空间一下子就开始虚化了起来，犹如水波一般，不断地晃荡着。
然后山羊就冲进了那片犹如水波一般的空间之中，再出现的时候，两只羊角已经撞中了两个混沌神的身体。
砰砰两声，那两个混沌神的躯体直接就被两只羊角洞穿，挂在羊角之上。
对于山羊来说，只要没有开天神，以它的实力面对混沌神，其实还是比较轻松的。
而这个时候，那条大蛇虽然身受重伤，但是看到三个同伴赶来，瞬间就燃起了希望，粗大的蛇躯之上，荡漾出一圈圈玄奥的符文，那些符文加持在蛇鳞之上，顿时就让那些蛇鳞变得更加坚硬。
同时，猴子和老牛这个时候也在不断地攻击其他那些混沌神。
三头动物一阵冲杀之下，之前围在大蛇周围的生灵最起码被冲散了一半。有了这三头动物的举动，让叶云飞和混老的行动更加隐秘。
“好了，我已经在周围的空间做好了布置，现在随时可以限制这些家伙的举动。”
混老对叶云飞说道。
就这么短暂的时间内，他已经彻底控制了周围的空间。
“那好，混老，你马上将这些家伙全部都镇压住，然后我来对付他们。”
叶云飞点头。
接着混老开始施法扭曲周围的空间，层层叠叠的空间形状开始变得奇形怪状起来，朝着那些生灵镇压过去，那些生灵面对层层叠叠挤压过来的空间，顿时就开始行动艰难。
而叶云飞这个时候已经快速出手，逐一攻击那些混沌神。
那两个开天神的感知能力比较敏锐，很快就发现事情不对劲，可是他们自身的行动也受到了严重的压制。当他们想要查找原因的时候，却发现感知不到任何的异样。
他们所能够感知得到的就是周围的空间在不断地扭曲变形，以各种奇怪的形状向他们所在的位置挤压过来。
“看来有一个空间修为极高的强者正在对我们动手。

这家伙太厉害了，可以控制周围的空间对我们进行攻击，我现在行动已经有点不便了，除非我们能够打破这里的空间镇压，否则我们不是对手。”
一个开天神对另一个开天神传音说道。
接着这两个开天神祭出他们的法宝，施展各种绝杀大招，想要打破周围的空间对他们的镇压。但是根本就没有用，他们动用的所有手段都被周围的空间强势镇压，而且更加可怕的是，他们轰出去的那些法宝，打出去的那些功法秘术竟然会改变方向，甚至有几件法宝拐了一个弯就朝他们自身砸了回来。
这是混老在控制空间的方向，通过扭曲空间，让那些法宝改变了方向。这种利用空间改变方向的手段十分罕见，就算是开天神也叹为观止，眼前这两个第一重开天神根本就没有应对的手段。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 4738 of Nine Yang Martial God: Domineering Soul Technique (..la) But soon, a large number of Chaos Gods reacted and began to work together to besiege the three animals.
"It's just you guys, no matter how many there are, I'm not afraid."
The old cow became more capable of killing, and its two horns continued to enlarge, roaring and slashing forward.
With the strength of these three animals, they will not be afraid at all when encountering creatures at the level of the Chaos God. The reason why they were beaten so badly before was because Kaitian Shen was among them.
The two Kaitian gods were attacking the big snake. Together, the two Kaitian gods had completely suppressed the big snake and were preparing to launch the final attack to completely suppress the big snake. At this critical moment, three animals, the old cow, the goat and the monkey, happened to arrive.
"Three more animals are here. These three animals are also of extraordinary blood. They are all ancient beast species."
The two Kaitian gods were surprised and happy to see the three animals.
Because with their perceptual abilities, they can sense that the blood in the bodies of these three newly arrived animals is very ancient, they have survived for a long time, and they are full of treasures.
"Great, there are four ancient beasts with extraordinary blood here. Then the two of us can get two ancient beasts each."
The two Kaitian gods communicated with each other to discuss.
"It's just that now that these four animals are together, the overall strength is not weak. It may be more difficult to deal with them."
One of the Kaitian gods frowned slightly.
"What are you afraid of?
These four ancient beasts are no match for the two of us, not to mention there are so many Chaos Gods here, we can definitely suppress them. "
The other Kaitian God was dismissive and didn't take these four animals to heart at all.
They simply didn't know that at this time, Mr. Hun had quietly used secret techniques to control the space around him, and Ye Yunfei was also quickly setting up formations and ground formations one by one.
Because the invisibility effect of Hun Lao and Ye Yunfei was so good, and because Hun Lao distorted and isolated the space as soon as he made a move, even the two Kaitian Gods did not notice the actions of Ye Yunfei and Hun Lao.
"Don't panic, everyone. The most powerful thing about these four ancient beasts is their strength and their hard bodies. They are good at close combat. We stay away from them and use magic weapons and various secret techniques to attack from a distance. We don't give them a chance to get close. In this way, their combat effectiveness can be slowly consumed, and then they will have no choice but to be slaughtered by us."
One of the Kaitians shouted loudly.
I have to say that he did see the characteristics of these four animals. These four animals followed the powerful demon god in ancient times. What they are best at is physical strength and extremely hard bodies. Once they get close to them during the battle, they will have to face their terrifying bodies and strength.
After hearing the words of the Kaitian God, the other Chaos Gods immediately retreated at the same time. Then they sacrificed magic weapons one by one, performed various secret techniques, and began to attack the four animals from a distance.
"Just you guys, no matter how you fight, you are no match for us."
The monkey sneered and said, then he flashed and jumped into the air. The golden iron rod in his hand continued to expand, and instantly turned into a pillar supporting the sky, like a golden mountain range. It rumbled forward and swept forward, blocking a large number of attacks at once.
Then the goat rushed forward, and its two horns continued to expand, piercing the space in front of it. The goat's two horns contained very clever space laws, and the space in front suddenly began to blur, like water waves, constantly swaying.
Then the goat rushed into the space like water waves. When it reappeared, the two goat horns had hit the bodies of the two chaos gods.
With two bangs, the bodies of the two Chaos Gods were directly pierced by the two horns and hung on the horns.
For goats, as long as there is noWith the Kaitian God, it is actually relatively easy to face the Chaos God with its strength.
At this time, although the big snake was seriously injured, when he saw the three companions arriving, he instantly ignited hope. Circles of mysterious runes rippled out from the thick snake body. Those runes were blessed on the snake scales, which immediately made those snake scales harder.
At the same time, Monkey and Lao Niu were also constantly attacking other Chaos Gods at this time.
Under the sudden charge of the three animals, at least half of the creatures that had been surrounding the big snake were scattered. The actions of these three animals made Ye Yunfei and Hun Lao's actions even more secretive.
"Okay, I have made arrangements in the surrounding space, and I can restrict these guys' movements at any time."
Mr. Hun said to Ye Yunfei.
In such a short period of time, he had completely controlled the surrounding space.
"Okay, Mr. Hun, you suppress all these guys immediately, and then I will deal with them."
Ye Yunfei nodded.
Then Mr. Hun began to cast spells to distort the surrounding space. The shapes of the layers of space began to become grotesque and moved toward the creatures. Those creatures immediately began to have difficulty moving in the face of the layers of space squeezed in.
Ye Yunfei had already taken action quickly at this time, attacking the Chaos Gods one by one.
The perception abilities of the two Kaitian Gods were relatively sharp, and they quickly discovered that something was wrong, but their own actions were also severely suppressed. When they tried to find the reason, they found that they couldn't sense anything strange.
All they can perceive is that the surrounding space is constantly distorting and deforming, squeezing towards their location in various strange shapes.
“It seems that there is a strong man with extremely high space cultivation who is attacking us.
This guy is so powerful that he can control the surrounding space to attack us. It's a bit inconvenient for me to move now. Unless we can break the spatial suppression here, we are no match. "
One Kaitian God sent a message to another Kaitian God.
Then the two Kaitian Gods sacrificed their magic weapons and used various ultimate moves to break the suppression of them by the surrounding space. But it was of no use at all. All the methods they used were suppressed by the surrounding space. What was even more frightening was that the magic weapons they blasted out and the secret techniques they fired actually changed directions. Some magic weapons even turned a corner and hit them back.
This is Old Man Hun controlling the direction of space. By distorting space, he makes those magic weapons change the direction. This method of using space to change direction is very rare. Even the Kaitian gods are amazed. The two first-level Kaitian gods in front of them have no means to deal with it.
